links.comparator_used: Original, unsimplified craniofacial patient education excerpts (readability scored by calculators)
links.outcome: Readability grade level of patient education excerpts
links.effect: Simplified excerpts' scores were significantly lower than the originals (P < 0.001); mean of simplified excerpts was 7.78, below the maximum recommended 8.
links.quote: It was also able to simplify materials to the recommended grade levels.
